sloka: तवादर्शनजः शोको भूयो मां परितापयेत् ।दुःखाद्दुःखपरामृष्टां दीपयन्निव वानर ।। ५.३९.२३।।।।
transliteration: tavādarśanajaḥ śoko bhūyo māṁ paritāpayet ।duḥkhādduḥkhaparāmṛṣṭāṁ dīpayanniva vānara ।। 5.39.23।।।।

translations.english: "My agony would be increased further by not seeing you. It would be inflamming my agony and I would be even more pained.
